d:
Inspired by the rich folk-art form of Gondhal from Maharashtra, this track channels the essence of this vibrant culture through rap. Blending traditional roots with modern rhythms, it’s a unique expression of thoughts and feelings that pays homage to Gondhal while delivering a fresh, lyrical twist.
